cases.subject: Science
cases.question: Why does a ball fall to the ground?
expected_facts: A dropped ball falls toward the ground
teaching_constraints: Avoid equations and advanced force terminology

cases.subject: Science
cases.question: How does my shadow form?
expected_facts: An object blocking light makes a darker area behind it
teaching_constraints: Use sunlight or a lamp as an example
Do not claim a shadow is a physical object

cases.subject: Science
cases.domain: A World of Ice and Water
cases.question: How are ice and water different?
expected_facts: Heating and cooling can change the form

cases.subject: Science
cases.question: Is opening a drawer a push or a pull?
expected_facts: A pull moves the drawer toward you
Closing the drawer usually uses a push

cases.subject: Science
cases.question: What is an atom?
expected_facts: Atoms are very small building blocks of matter
Different elements have different kinds of atoms
teaching_constraints: Use a simple analogy but state its limit
Do not present an atom as a tiny solar system
